### Issues (LOW, advisory)
[LOW][statement-ambiguity] L2 shorthand omits `full: true`
File: `.scratch/token-efficient-tool-responses/ticket05-spec-r16.md:14` (also :46)
ID: CR-R16-1 · Confidence: HIGH
Issue: “`full` and `fields` together ⇒ malformed_request” literally fires for `{full:false, fields:[…]}`, which AC3:98 pins to fields mode (mapping). Resolved by the AC, not by the ladder text.
Fix: write “`full: true` + `fields`” in R4(2), design L2, row 21.

[LOW][statement-ambiguity] AC4 L5 clause lacks L1–L4 precedence
File: :99 vs :98
ID: CR-R16-2 · Confidence: HIGH
Issue: AC4 says fields on non-matching ops → L5 `not_supported` unqualified; AC3 sends non-matching + duplicate fields to L4 `malformed_request`. Ladder resolves it; text does not.
Fix: qualify AC4 with “statically valid `fields` (after L1–L4)”.

File: :50
ID: CR-R16-3 · Confidence: HIGH
Issue: Contradicts the same sentence’s “first matching step” and composites that match two steps.
Fix: “No pre-dispatch input resolves to more than one step; the first matching step declares the reason.”

[LOW][traceability] §9 count and ladder row labels
File: :147, :45-48
ID: CR-R16-4 · Confidence: HIGH
Issue: “the three composite inputs” followed by four; ladder cites “[former row 21a/21b/21c]” although r15’s D-table had a single row 21 (21 rows total); §10:156 repeats it.
Fix: “four composite inputs”; cite ladder steps or actual rows.
